properties.Caption: Customer Card
properties.AdditionalSearchTerms: Customer Profile, Client Details, Buyer Information, Customer Data, Customer View, Client Profile, Customer Detail, Client Info
properties.AboutText: With the **Customer Card** you manage information about a customer and specify the terms of business, such as payment terms, prices and discounts. From here you can also drill down on past and ongoing sales activity.

procedures.name: RunReport
procedures.doc: Runs the specified report filtered to a single customer.

controls.tooltip: Specifies the Classification of Enterprises and Organizations code associated with the customer.

controls.name: Customized Calendar
controls.caption: Customized Calendar
controls.tooltip: Specifies that you have set up a customized version of a base calendar.

controls.name: CustomerSince
controls.caption: Customer Since
controls.tooltip: Specifies the date when the first transaction with the customer was recorded.

controls.name: DaysSinceLastSale
controls.caption: Days Since Last Sale
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of days since you last had a sale to the customer.

controls.name: DistinctItemsSold
controls.caption: Distinct Items Sold
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of distinct items that you have sold to the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: ExpectedCustMoneyOwed
controls.caption: Money Owed - Expected
controls.tooltip: Specifies the payment amount that the customer will owe when ongoing sales invoices and credit memos are completed. The value is calculated asynchronously so there might be a delay in updating this field.

controls.name: TotalMoneyOwed
controls.caption: Money Owed - Total
controls.tooltip: Specifies the payment amount that the customer owes for completed sales plus sales that are still ongoing. The value is calculated asynchronously so there might be a delay in updating this field.

controls.name: CalcCreditLimitLCYExpendedPct
controls.caption: Usage Of Credit Limit
controls.tooltip: Specifies how much of the customer's payment balance consists of credit.

controls.name: Balance Due
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of outstanding payments from the customer.

controls.name: Payments (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of payments received from the customer in the current fiscal year. Current fiscal year is determined by the system date. The value shown here is calculated asynchronously so there might be a delay in updating this field.

controls.name: CustomerMgt.AvgDaysToPay(""No."")
controls.caption: Average Collection Period (Days)
controls.tooltip: Specifies how long the customer typically takes to pay invoices in the current fiscal year. The value is calculated asynchronously so there might be a delay in updating this field.

controls.name: DaysPaidPastDueDate
controls.caption: Average Late Payments (Days)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the average number of days the customer is late with payments. The value is calculated asynchronously so there might be a delay in updating this field.

controls.name: PaidLateCount
controls.caption: Invoices Paid Late
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of invoices that were paid late by the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: PaidOnTimeCount
controls.caption: Invoices Paid On Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of invoices that were paid on time by the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: PercentPaidLate
controls.caption: Percent Paid Late
controls.tooltip: Specifies the percentage of invoices that were paid late by the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: OverdueCount
controls.caption: Overdue Payments Count
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of overdue payments for the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: LastPaymentDate
controls.caption: Last Payment Receipt Date
controls.tooltip: Specifies the date of the last payment received from the customer.

controls.name: LastPaymentAmount
controls.caption: Last Payment Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of the last payment received from the customer.

controls.name: LastPaymentOnTime
controls.caption: Last Payment On Time
controls.tooltip: Specifies whether the last payment was applied before the due date.

controls.name: AmountOnPostedInvoices
controls.tooltip: Specifies your sales to the customer in the current fiscal year based on posted sales invoices. The figure in parenthesis Specifies the number of posted sales invoices.

controls.name: AmountOnCrMemo
controls.tooltip: Specifies your expected refunds to the customer in the current fiscal year based on posted sales credit memos. The figure in parenthesis shows the number of posted sales credit memos.

controls.name: AmountOnOutstandingInvoices
controls.tooltip: Specifies your expected sales to the customer in the current fiscal year based on ongoing sales invoices. The figure in parenthesis shows the number of ongoing sales invoices.

controls.name: AmountOnOutstandingCrMemos
controls.tooltip: Specifies your refunds to the customer in the current fiscal year based on ongoing sales credit memos. The figure in parenthesis shows the number of ongoing sales credit memos.

controls.name: Totals
controls.caption: Total Sales
controls.tooltip: Specifies your total sales turnover with the customer in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts excluding VAT on all completed and open invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: CustInvDiscAmountLCY
controls.caption: Invoice Discounts
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total of all invoice discounts that you have granted to the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: InteractionCount
controls.caption: Interactions
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of interactions that you have had with the customer in the current fiscal year.

controls.name: LastInteractionDate
controls.caption: Last Interaction Date
controls.tooltip: Specifies the date when you last had an interaction with the customer.

controls.name: LastInteractionType
controls.caption: Last Interaction Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the last interaction that you had with the customer.

controls.name: MostFrequentInteractionType
controls.caption: Most Frequent Interaction Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of interaction that you have most frequently with the customer in the current fiscal year.

properties.AboutText: Here you overview all registered vendors that you purchase goods and services from. With [Vendor Templates](?page=1385 "Opens the Vendor Templates") you can quickly register new vendors having common details defined by the template.

controls.name: No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unique number that identifies the vendor. You can assign numbers automatically based on a number series or assign them manually.

controls.name: Name
controls.tooltip: Specifies the vendor's name that appears on all related documents. For companies, specify the company's name here, and then add the relevant people as contacts that you link to this vendor.

controls.name: Location Code2
controls.tooltip: Specifies the warehouse location where items from the vendor must be received by default.

controls.name: Balance (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of your completed purchases from the vendor in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts including VAT on all completed purchase invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: Balance Due (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of your unpaid purchases from the vendor in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts including VAT on all open purchase invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: Payments (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of payments paid to the vendor.
